_doc: Hand-reviewed per-model decisions the feed builder cannot read reliably from upstream's prose. launcher: "unsupported" means KanTV offers the debloat only and never attempts the launcher install. "os" keys match a substring of tv.json's os field. Each entry cites the upstream header line it rests on; review again when upstream.lock.json is bumped.

ffalcon-r34a0-cn.source: the launcher signature gate ... Conclusion: debloat only, stock CyberUI launcher stays

tcl-mt9655-cn-android14.source: Sideloading and the launcher: both are locked

tcl-q10g-pro.source: A third-party launcher cannot be installed here

tcl-ak30a5.source: APKs that declare android.intent.category.HOME are refused at parse time unless they are signed ... A third-party launcher therefore cannot be installed on this model at all

Fire OS.source: FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. com.amazon.tv.launcher keeps Home (every Fire OS list, Amazon and Hisense-built)
